claim: Polynomial-time many-one coNP-hardness of nonnegative legal chip-firing reachability on loopless strongly connected binary-encoded directed multigraphs; together with Hujter–Kiss–Tóthmérész Theorem 12, coNP-completeness of this language.
scope_exclusions: No claim that finite tests constitute a proof.
acceptance_basis: Complete written analytic reduction and separate mathematical audit; Farrell–Levine Corollary 3.2 supplies source NP-completeness and Hujter–Kiss–Tóthmérész Theorem 12 supplies target coNP membership. Finite checks are supporting metadata only.
sources_verified_scope: Recorded proof-review and independent-audit observations; edition preparation did not retrieve, rehash, or inspect scholarly sources anew.
